gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: The dragon forge can most quickly be accessed from the Ancient Cavern by activating a Slayer cape's teleport perk, teleporting to Kuradal and running south. Players can also use a ferocious ring to teleport to her if they do not have level 99 Slayer. Otherwise, a games necklace teleport to Barbarian Outpost and running south into the whirlpool is the quickest route.

8821.d: The Dragonkin Laboratory is the second Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and tokens, located in the Deep Wilderness Castle Ruins.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
• Use a Dragonkin Laboratory teleport, which can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop.
• Walk east of the Demonic Ruins to the peninsula north of Daemonheim (requires travelling through the Wilderness).
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, or the Dungeoneering cape to teleport to the Daemonheim Peninsula Island. From there, run east down the mountain to the treasure chest located by the Fremennik ship. Use the teleport option on the chest and select Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
• Use the Grouping System to teleport.
